venue_name: Gryps RFQ Perps v1 (Orbs solver, SEI / Symmio settlement)

quirks.title: Trading fees are per-symbol tiered data, not a constant
quirks.detail: The solver registry carries at least three distinct trading_fee values across symbols (0.5, 5, and 10 bps observed 2026-07-10). Majors sit at 0.5 bps; some symbols carry 10-20x that.
quirks.agent_rule: Read trading_fee, hedger_fee_open, hedger_fee_close from the registry per symbol at decision time. Never hardcode a fee constant anywhere in strategy logic.

quirks.title: Hedger fee applies on open AND close — ~21 bps realized round-trip on majors
quirks.detail: hedger_fee_open and hedger_fee_close are each 10 bps on majors; with 0.5 bps platform fee x2 the measured cohort friction signature was -21.66 bps round-trip (123 attributed trades). Realized cost is roughly double what a single-side reading suggests.
quirks.agent_rule: Model round-trip cost as (trading_fee + hedger_fee_open) + (trading_fee + hedger_fee_close) on notional. Strategies with expected edge below ~25 bps round-trip on majors are structurally unprofitable here.
quirks.verification_method: registry fields + Observatory PnL attribution vs Coinbase reference

quirks.title: realizedPnl is GROSS of fees; fees debit separately on every fill including opens
quirks.detail: Account identity: balance = deposits + sum(realizedPnl) - sum(fees) + funding. Treating realizedPnl as net double-counts fees and inflates apparent performance.
quirks.agent_rule: Never treat realizedPnl as net performance. Reconcile with the full identity; expect a fee debit on open fills, not only closes.

quirks.title: Funding accrues on a 4h grid; positive accumulatedFunding DEBITS the account
quirks.detail: Funding epochs at 00/04/08/12/16/20 UTC (some symbols 8h — read funding_rate_epoch_duration_ms). Sign convention is inverted vs several venues: positive accumulatedFunding is a charge to the position holder. Observed rate was a flat 0.005% of mark notional per tick with no premium component [unverified beyond two ticks].
quirks.agent_rule: Read funding_rate_epoch_duration_ms per symbol. Treat positive accumulatedFunding as cost. Do not assume shorts receive funding — unverified on this venue.
quirks.verification_method: funding reconciliation across two observed ticks, hedger-side identity exact

quirks.title: "Zero slippage" means zero slippage FROM THE QUOTED PRICE, briefly held
quirks.detail: The RFQ quote holds for a short window and fills at quoted price; it does not eliminate the spread between quote and index mid. CTO-confirmed. Cohort measurement: ~10 bps average per-side skew vs external reference.
quirks.agent_rule: Benchmark fills against an independent external reference (not the venue mark) to measure true execution quality.

quirks.title: Per-ticket notional caps vary 70k-4M USD by symbol; stated cap != quoted depth
quirks.detail: max_notional_value ranges from $50k (thin tails) through $800k (mid caps) to $4M (majors, commodities). Whether a solver actually quotes the max on thin symbols is a hedger-depth question, not a registry guarantee.
quirks.agent_rule: Read min/max_notional_value per symbol. For size above the cap, split across tickets and expect requote risk between fills. Probe realistic depth with small clips before committing size on thin symbols.

quirks.title: The solver contract-symbols endpoint is the venue's listings source of truth
quirks.detail: 659 symbols (2026-07-10), all valid + rfq_allowed. Public, keyless. Whether the UI suppresses any registry symbols client-side is unverified.
quirks.agent_rule: Derive market lists, fees, leverage, and caps from this endpoint at runtime; date-stamp any cached copy.

quirks.title: Programmatic order flow is not sanctioned on v1; agent flow raced the production hedger
quirks.detail: Direct agent submission via the v1 path exposed backend timing vulnerabilities (May 2026) and the team requested a pause. v1 is not agent-safe for writes; v2 is the sanctioned agent path once its API relocates.
quirks.agent_rule: Do not run autonomous order flow against v1. Read-only integration only, until the venue provides an agent-sanctioned path.

quirks.title: Multi-venue settlement layer is transitioning architectures
quirks.detail: Current v1 settlement is Symmio-based on SEI; next protocol version moves multi-venue settlement to a different architecture. Use architecture-agnostic language and expect settlement-adjacent APIs to change.
quirks.agent_rule: Do not couple tooling to Symmio-specific artifacts for forward-looking work; isolate settlement assumptions behind the venue adapter.
